rationale: Calum Scott's cover of Robyn's 'Dancing On My Own' was his debut solo single, released March 2016 (UK No. 2), per Qobuz and AXS/Rovi bios. 'Hot Party Winter 2017' is a compilation. The canonical original is the 2016 debut single (also appears on his 2018 debut album 'Only Human'). | sources: https://www.qobuz.com/se-en/interpreter/calum-scott/2566079, https://axs.tv/artists/calum-scott/
